'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[Islamabad Memorandum]]
*****[[International Atomic Energy Agency]] (IAEA) secretary-general [[Rafael Grossi]] says that the interim [[2026 Iran war ceasefire|ceasefire]] [[Islamabad Memorandum|peace deal]] between [[Iran]] and the [[United States]] would allow the IAEA access to [[Nuclear program of Iran|Iran's nuclear inspectors]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-deal-grants-access-nuclear-inspectors-iaea-chief-says-2026-06-26/ (Reuters)]
*****A direct communications line between Iran and the U.S. is established under Article 5 of the [[memorandum of understanding]] over the [[Strait of Hormuz]] in an effort to prevent incidents that could lead to military confrontation. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/us-israel-iran-war/iran-says-direct-communication-line-established-with-us-over-hormuz-to-avoid-military-confrontation/3979011 (AA)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign]]
*****The [[International Maritime Organization]] says that 115 vessels and 2,500 seafarers have been evacuated from the [[Strait of Hormuz]] since the plan was announced. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/115-vessels-2-500-seafarers-evacuated-from-strait-of-hormuz-un-agency/3979176 (AA)]
*****The [[United States Central Command]] says [[United States Armed Forces|its forces]] have conducted airstrikes on Iran in response to yesterday's drone strike on a civilian [[Singapore]]-flagged [[cargo ship]] transiting the Strait of Hormuz, striking [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian]] missile and [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drone]] storage sites, and coastal [[radar]] sites. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-military-conducted-strikes-area-strait-hormuz-axios-reports-2026-06-26/ (Reuters)]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks]]
****[[Israeli occupation of Southern Lebanon (2026)|Israeli occupation of Southern Lebanon]]
*****[[Israel]], [[Lebanon]], and the United States sign a trilateral [[framework agreement]] in [[Washington, D.C]], that provides for the transfer of two [[Israeli-occupied territories|Israeli-held areas]] to [[Lebanese army]] control and establishes a process for [[Disarmament of Hezbollah|the disarmament]] of [[Hezbollah]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260626-lebanon-israel-us-sign-trilateral-framework-agreement-in-washington (AFP via RFI)] [https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/320949-full-text-of-lebanon-israel-framework-agreement (''Axios'' via Naharnet)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-drops-leaflets-over-south-lebanon-town-ordering-residents-leave-2026-06-26/ (Reuters)]
*****[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] states that [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] will remain in [[southern Lebanon]] until Hezbollah disarms, despite the framework agreement. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/06/26/lebanon-israel-us-sign-trilateral-framework-agreement-in-washington_6754914_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')] [https://english.news.cn/20260627/82856543881144798be1f4a14474e974/c.html (Xinhua)]
*****Netanyahu states that [[Lebanese displacement during the Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|displaced Lebanese civilians]] will not be permitted to return to areas within the Israeli-controlled security zone in southern Lebanon under arrangements announced following the agreement. [https://www.dawn.com/news/2011084/netanyahu-says-lebanese-displaced-from-security-zone-not-allowed-to-return (AFP via ''Dawn'')]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***A [[state of emergency]] is declared in [[Russia]]n-[[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|occupied]] [[Crimea]] in response to an increasing number of [[airstrike]]s by [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/26/world/europe/crimea-ukraine-state-emergency.html?unlocked_article_code=1.tFA.W5dS.V-TkawkftFqz&smid=url-share (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Ukraine]] launches its largest [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on Russia since the start of the war, with over 660 drones launched at multiple [[Federal subjects of Russia|regions]], including [[Moscow Oblast]], as [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says he has approved a "40-day campaign" aimed at "compelling Russia to end the war". [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-biggest-drone-attack-a356e2a119f3cb9422ede6acbedf56f3 (AP)]
**[[Prisoners of war in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Prisoners of war in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***Russia and Ukraine exchange [[Prisoner of war|prisoners of war]], with each side releasing 160 people. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/27/ukraine-war-briefing-russian-occupied-crimea-declares-emergency-as-zelenskyys-forces-step-up-attacks (''The Guardian'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 European heatwaves]]
**[[Energy in Switzerland|Swiss energy]] utility [[Axpo Holding|Axpo]] suspends operations at the [[Beznau Nuclear Power Plant]] in [[Döttingen, Aargau|Döttingen]], [[Aargau]], [[Switzerland]], after the temperature of the [[Aare]] river, which the plant uses for cooling, reached {{convert|25|C|F}}. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/nuclear-plant-in-switzerland-shut-down-due-to-heatwave (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
**The [[Met Office]] records the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[United Kingdom weather records|highest temperature]] in June after a provisional high of {{convert|37.3|C|F}} is recorded in [[Santon Downham]], [[Suffolk]], breaking the previous record high set yesterday in [[Somerset]], while [[wildfire]]s spread in [[Derbyshire]] burning approximately 22 hectares across the [[High Peak, Derbyshire|High Peak]] [[moorland|moor]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c7vy8ql6rgnt (BBC News)]
*[[Central African Republic]] [[Health in the Central African Republic|health]] [[Central African Republic Council of Ministers|minister]] [[Pierre Somsé]] declares a [[cholera]] outbreak in the districts of [[Bimbo, Central African Republic|Bimbo]] and [[Mbaïki]] following 24 deaths from the disease. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/health/central-african-republic-declares-cholera-outbreak-after-24-deaths-report/3979939 (AA)] [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2648782/amp (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

*[[Gen Z protests]] 
**[[2025–2026 Indonesian protests]]
***[[Indonesia]]n [[Indonesian National Police|police]] arrest at least 24 protesters following a demonstration in [[Surabaya]], [[East Java]], against [[Energy in Indonesia|fuel]] price increases and [[Red and White Cabinet|government]] policies. The arrests occur after clashes in which some participants threw objects and set fires in the street. [https://apnews.com/article/tanzania-political-rallies-ban-830f6a6db6ac7d8573b12e146006cd35 (AP)]

**The [[European Union]] imposes strict [[Visa requirements for Somali citizens|visa restrictions]] on [[Somali passport|Somali diplomatic passport]] holders following a dispute over the [[deportation]] and readmission of undocumented [[Somalis]] living illegally in [[Europe]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/26/eu-targets-somalia-with-visa-curbs-as-president-pushes-back-on-returns (Al Jazeera)] [https://africa.businessinsider.com/local/lifestyle/europes-africa-migration-strategy-faces-a-test-as-somalia-rejects-unverified/3slxfdn (''Business Insider'')] [https://www.politico.eu/article/the-eu-targets-somalia-next-in-its-anti-migration-push/ (''Politico'')]
